instrumentation.gate: Native replay tolerance1e-10; finite sensor stamps, no future beyond1ms; joint age<=10ms, GT age<=40ms, abs skew<=40ms; common-grid whole/crossing coverage>=98%; both physical arrival/2s-stop pass. Fail means STOP without retry or parameter change.

controllers.candidate: reactive cruise0.400 target0.90 maxhold1.0; frozen config

order: shuffle within paired cold-start blocks; order RNG76850 for instrumentation,76950+i for scenarios; not identical snapshots
measurement: Same 50Hz grid and offset+10ms for whole/crossing. Crossing first+50ms to GT body normal-plane distance0.50m beyond cable. Native vertical and fixed2s event vibration retained; no true impulse claim.

gates.arrival_stop: All reference/candidate arrivals and2s-stops; failed outcomes retained
gates.time: mean candidate time<=1.05*PI; not a time-matched claim
gates.slip: mean whole RMS and postcontact slip2/m ratios<1 on both grid origins; >=3/4 scenario means improve both metrics at both origins
gates.decision: All gates pass: eligible for future bounded classical tuning, never automatic. Grid reversal: measurement-first. Otherwise one saved-trace audit; no extra simulations.

reporting_thresholds_qualification: Design limits for this simulation screen based on existing2ms wheel/20ms GT cadence, not hardware or industry standards
constraints: Physics, PI, robot, detector, ramp and scoring fixed. Only cable position/yaw differ across four novel scenarios; traversal not presumed. No test-based selection.
